en.name: Aquarium planting soil
en.summary: May lower pH and hardness; fresh soil may release ammonia. Follow product preparation and establish stable water before adding animals.
en.description: May lower pH and hardness; fresh soil may release ammonia. Follow product preparation and establish stable water before adding animals.

zh-CN.name: 水草泥
zh-CN.summary: 可能降低pH和硬度，新泥可能释放氨。按产品准备并完成水质稳定后再加入动物。
zh-CN.description: 可能降低pH和硬度，新泥可能释放氨。按产品准备并完成水质稳定后再加入动物。

preparation.en: May lower pH and hardness; fresh soil may release ammonia. Follow product preparation and establish stable water before adding animals.
preparation.zh-CN: 可能降低pH和硬度，新泥可能释放氨。按产品准备并完成水质稳定后再加入动物。

en.name: Inert planted substrate
en.summary: This entry denotes substrate of confirmed inert composition; it makes no nutrient guarantee. Assess root feeding separately.
en.description: This entry denotes substrate of confirmed inert composition; it makes no nutrient guarantee. Assess root feeding separately.

zh-CN.name: 惰性底床
zh-CN.summary: 本条目指成分已确认的惰性底床；不含肥力保证，根肥需求另行评估。
zh-CN.description: 本条目指成分已确认的惰性底床；不含肥力保证，根肥需求另行评估。

preparation.en: This entry denotes substrate of confirmed inert composition; it makes no nutrient guarantee. Assess root feeding separately.
preparation.zh-CN: 本条目指成分已确认的惰性底床；不含肥力保证，根肥需求另行评估。

en.name: Chunk driftwood
en.summary: Remove decayed areas, soak and secure. Tannin release varies with wood and time.
en.description: Remove decayed areas, soak and secure. Tannin release varies with wood and time.

zh-CN.name: 块状沉木
zh-CN.summary: 清除腐烂部分并浸泡固定，单宁释放量随木材和时间变化。
zh-CN.description: 清除腐烂部分并浸泡固定，单宁释放量随木材和时间变化。

preparation.en: Remove decayed areas, soak and secure. Tannin release varies with wood and time.
preparation.zh-CN: 清除腐烂部分并浸泡固定，单宁释放量随木材和时间变化。

en.name: Branch driftwood
en.summary: Use untreated aquarium-safe wood. Soak and secure; tannins may colour water.
en.description: Use untreated aquarium-safe wood. Soak and secure; tannins may colour water.

zh-CN.name: 分枝沉木
zh-CN.summary: 选无涂层水族沉木，浸泡固定；可能释放单宁并使水色变深。
zh-CN.description: 选无涂层水族沉木，浸泡固定；可能释放单宁并使水色变深。

preparation.en: Use untreated aquarium-safe wood. Soak and secure; tannins may colour water.
preparation.zh-CN: 选无涂层水族沉木，浸泡固定；可能释放单宁并使水色变深。

en.name: Smooth fine gravel
en.summary: Use smooth grains. Check composition and rinse; avoid abrasive edges near bottom feeders.
en.description: Use smooth grains. Check composition and rinse; avoid abrasive edges near bottom feeders.

zh-CN.name: 圆润细砾
zh-CN.summary: 使用圆润颗粒，检查成分并清洗，避免伤及底栖鱼触须。
zh-CN.description: 使用圆润颗粒，检查成分并清洗，避免伤及底栖鱼触须。

preparation.en: Use smooth grains. Check composition and rinse; avoid abrasive edges near bottom feeders.
preparation.zh-CN: 使用圆润颗粒，检查成分并清洗，避免伤及底栖鱼触须。

en.name: Fine silica sand
en.summary: Use clean aquarium-grade silica sand and rinse thoroughly. This does not imply all sand is inert.
en.description: Use clean aquarium-grade silica sand and rinse thoroughly. This does not imply all sand is inert.

zh-CN.name: 细砂
zh-CN.summary: 选适用于水族的洁净硅砂，充分漂洗；不要将名称推广为所有砂材均惰性。
zh-CN.description: 选适用于水族的洁净硅砂，充分漂洗；不要将名称推广为所有砂材均惰性。

preparation.en: Use clean aquarium-grade silica sand and rinse thoroughly. This does not imply all sand is inert.
preparation.zh-CN: 选适用于水族的洁净硅砂，充分漂洗；不要将名称推广为所有砂材均惰性。

en.name: Slate rock
en.summary: Inspect sharp edges and inclusions. Scrub and secure; appearance alone does not prove inertness.
en.description: Inspect sharp edges and inclusions. Scrub and secure; appearance alone does not prove inertness.

zh-CN.name: 板岩石
zh-CN.summary: 检查锐边及矿物夹杂；刷洗后摆稳，不能仅凭外观假定惰性。
zh-CN.description: 检查锐边及矿物夹杂；刷洗后摆稳，不能仅凭外观假定惰性。

preparation.en: Inspect sharp edges and inclusions. Scrub and secure; appearance alone does not prove inertness.
preparation.zh-CN: 检查锐边及矿物夹杂；刷洗后摆稳，不能仅凭外观假定惰性。

en.name: Rounded river pebbles
en.summary: Use rock confirmed suitable for aquaria; composition varies and may contain carbonates. Test before use.
en.description: Use rock confirmed suitable for aquaria; composition varies and may contain carbonates. Test before use.

zh-CN.name: 圆润卵石
zh-CN.summary: 仅使用可确认适用于水族的石材；来源不同可能含碳酸盐，先检测。
zh-CN.description: 仅使用可确认适用于水族的石材；来源不同可能含碳酸盐，先检测。

preparation.en: Use rock confirmed suitable for aquaria; composition varies and may contain carbonates. Test before use.
preparation.zh-CN: 仅使用可确认适用于水族的石材；来源不同可能含碳酸盐，先检测。

en.name: Water wisteria
en.summary: Submerged leaf shape varies with conditions. Plant separated bunches and trim to avoid shading neighbours.
en.description: Submerged leaf shape varies with conditions. Plant separated bunches and trim to avoid shading neighbours.

zh-CN.name: 水蓑衣
zh-CN.summary: 沉水叶形会随条件变化。分丛种植并及时修剪，避免遮挡其他水草。
zh-CN.description: 沉水叶形会随条件变化。分丛种植并及时修剪，避免遮挡其他水草。

en.name: Tape grass
en.summary: Use in the background with room to grow. Keep the crown exposed; runners spread.
en.description: Use in the background with room to grow. Keep the crown exposed; runners spread.

zh-CN.name: 螺旋苦草
zh-CN.summary: 适合后景，保留生长空间，勿深埋生长点。匍匐茎会扩展。
zh-CN.description: 适合后景，保留生长空间，勿深埋生长点。匍匐茎会扩展。

en.name: Wendt’s crypt
en.summary: Root in substrate. Leaves may melt after a change of conditions; healthy roots can regrow.
en.description: Root in substrate. Leaves may melt after a change of conditions; healthy roots can regrow.

zh-CN.name: 温蒂椒草
zh-CN.summary: 根植底床，转水或环境变化后可能融叶；根部仍可重新萌芽。
zh-CN.description: 根植底床，转水或环境变化后可能融叶；根部仍可重新萌芽。

en.name: Java moss
en.summary: One portion is an editing unit; tie down a thin layer. Trim and remove accumulated debris.
en.description: One portion is an editing unit; tie down a thin layer. Trim and remove accumulated debris.

zh-CN.name: 爪哇莫丝
zh-CN.summary: 一份为编辑单位，可薄铺绑附。定期修剪并清除积屑。
zh-CN.description: 一份为编辑单位，可薄铺绑附。定期修剪并清除积屑。

media.attribution: Tsunamicarlos at English Wikipedia · Public domain

en.name: Java fern
en.summary: Attach the rhizome to wood or rock rather than burying it. Can grow without injected CO₂.
en.description: Attach the rhizome to wood or rock rather than burying it. Can grow without injected CO₂.

zh-CN.name: 爪哇蕨
zh-CN.summary: 根茎附着石木，不要深埋。可在无额外CO₂的缸中生长。
zh-CN.description: 根茎附着石木，不要深埋。可在无额外CO₂的缸中生长。

en.name: Anubias nana
en.summary: Attach to stone or wood; keep the rhizome above substrate. Tolerates low light and grows slowly.
en.description: Attach to stone or wood; keep the rhizome above substrate. Tolerates low light and grows slowly.

zh-CN.name: 小水榕
zh-CN.summary: 附着在石木上，根茎勿埋入底床。耐低光，生长缓慢。
zh-CN.description: 附着在石木上，根茎勿埋入底床。耐低光，生长缓慢。

notes.en: Reproduces in freshwater; excess food can increase numbers. Protect shells and manage leftovers; snails do not replace maintenance.
notes.zh-CN: 可在淡水繁殖，投喂过量可能使数量增加。保护壳体并控制剩食，不替代清洁。

en.name: Ramshorn snail
en.summary: Reproduces in freshwater; excess food can increase numbers.
en.description: Reproduces in freshwater; excess food can increase numbers. Protect shells and manage leftovers; snails do not replace maintenance.

zh-CN.name: 扁卷螺
zh-CN.summary: 可在淡水繁殖，投喂过量可能使数量增加
zh-CN.description: 可在淡水繁殖，投喂过量可能使数量增加。保护壳体并控制剩食，不替代清洁。

notes.en: Shells need adequate minerals; acidic water may erode them. Larval development requires brackish conditions. Grazing does not remove the need to assess food availability.
notes.zh-CN: 壳体需要足够矿物质，避免酸性水体侵蚀。幼体发育需要咸水条件；吃藻不代表无需补充食物。

en.name: Black helmet nerite
en.summary: Shells need adequate minerals; acidic water may erode them.
en.description: Shells need adequate minerals; acidic water may erode them. Larval development requires brackish conditions. Grazing does not remove the need to assess food availability.

zh-CN.name: 黑金刚螺
zh-CN.summary: 壳体需要足够矿物质，避免酸性水体侵蚀
zh-CN.description: 壳体需要足够矿物质，避免酸性水体侵蚀。幼体发育需要咸水条件；吃藻不代表无需补充食物。

notes.en: Keep filtration and gas exchange adequate for this larger fish. Provide circulation without removing sheltered resting places. Prioritize adult bottom area and a retreat; tank length is unconfirmed. House singly unless individual compatibility and space are assessed. Supply sinking vegetable-based foods; algae alone is insufficient. Provide wood and a suitable hiding place.
notes.zh-CN: 为这种体型较大的鱼维持足够过滤和气体交换。 保证水体循环，同时留有遮蔽休息处。 优先考虑成鱼底面积与躲避处；缸长尚未确认。 默认单养；增加个体前需评估个体相容性和空间。 提供沉底植物性食物，不能只靠缸壁藻类。 提供沉木和合适的躲避处。

media.attribution:
André Karwath aka Aka
 · CC BY-SA 2.5

en.name: Bristlenose Pleco
en.summary: A bottom-dwelling Ancistrus form whose adult size and waste need planning.
en.description: Common shop forms vary in exact identity. Provide hiding places and aquarium-safe wood, sinking food with a plant component and small portions of vegetables; remove leftovers. It produces waste and cannot replace maintenance.

zh-CN.name: 胡子异型
zh-CN.summary: 需要按成体尺寸和排泄负担规划的底栖胡子异型。
zh-CN.description: 常见商品品系的准确种名可能不同。提供躲避处和适用沉木，投喂含植物成分的沉底饲料及少量蔬菜，及时取出残饵；排泄量需考虑，不能代替清洁维护。

en.flow: Provide circulation without removing sheltered resting places.
en.group: House singly unless individual compatibility and space are assessed.
en.setup: Provide wood and a suitable hiding place.
en.space: Prioritize adult bottom area and a retreat; tank length is unconfirmed.
en.oxygen: Keep filtration and gas exchange adequate for this larger fish.
en.feeding: Supply sinking vegetable-based foods; algae alone is insufficient.

zh-CN.flow: 保证水体循环，同时留有遮蔽休息处。
zh-CN.group: 默认单养；增加个体前需评估个体相容性和空间。
zh-CN.setup: 提供沉木和合适的躲避处。
zh-CN.space: 优先考虑成鱼底面积与躲避处；缸长尚未确认。
zh-CN.oxygen: 为这种体型较大的鱼维持足够过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供沉底植物性食物，不能只靠缸壁藻类。

text.en: Individuals can dispute shelters and bottom territory, especially with limited space.
text.zh-CN: 个体可能争夺躲避处和底部领地，空间不足时尤需注意。

discovery.distribution: Captive-bred Ancistrus forms of South American origin

notes.en: Provide well-oxygenated water independently of current strength. Moderate circulation suits active swimming; retain a calmer resting area. Aim for about 60 cm of continuous swimming length and a secure lid. Keep at least 6 together, with enough swimming space for the group. Offer suitably sized food at the surface and in midwater. Keep a clear swim path and cover the tank to limit jumping.
notes.zh-CN: 无论水流强弱，都要保持较高溶氧。 适中水流便于活跃游动，也留一处平缓休息区。 争取约60厘米连续游泳长度，并加牢固缸盖。 至少6尾同养，并为群体保留足够游泳空间。 在水面和中层提供大小合适的食物。 保留连续游泳空间，盖好缸盖防跳。

en.name: Zebra Danio
en.summary: An active, striped schooling fish that needs a long swimming run.
en.description: Keep at least six and prioritise a tank about 60 cm long or longer over height alone. Secure the lid: these quick swimmers can jump.

zh-CN.name: 斑马鱼
zh-CN.summary: 游动活跃、需要连续游泳空间的条纹群游鱼。
zh-CN.description: 至少六尾群养，优先选择约60厘米或更长的缸体，不能只看高度或升数。它们游动快，也会跳缸，应加盖。

en.flow: Moderate circulation suits active swimming; retain a calmer resting area.
en.group: Keep at least 6 together, with enough swimming space for the group.
en.setup: Keep a clear swim path and cover the tank to limit jumping.
en.space: Aim for about 60 cm of continuous swimming length and a secure lid.
en.oxygen: Provide well-oxygenated water independently of current strength.
en.feeding: Offer suitably sized food at the surface and in midwater.

zh-CN.flow: 适中水流便于活跃游动，也留一处平缓休息区。
zh-CN.group: 至少6尾同养，并为群体保留足够游泳空间。
zh-CN.setup: 保留连续游泳空间，盖好缸盖防跳。
zh-CN.space: 争取约60厘米连续游泳长度，并加牢固缸盖。
zh-CN.oxygen: 无论水流强弱，都要保持较高溶氧。
zh-CN.feeding: 在水面和中层提供大小合适的食物。

text.en: Active swimmers may jump; keep the lid secure.
text.zh-CN: 活跃游泳时可能跳缸；请固定缸盖。

notes.en: Air breathing does not make stagnant or poor-quality water safe. Use gentle filtered circulation, especially for long fins. Provide accessible surface and places to rest. Keep a single betta; do not infer pair housing from the count of one. Offer suitable small foods near the surface without overfeeding. Use a secure lid and surface access, with cover for resting.
notes.zh-CN: 可呼吸空气也不代表停水或差水质安全。 保持缓和的过滤水流，长鳍品系尤其需要。 保证能到达水面，并有休息位置。 单养斗鱼；数量为一不意味着可以配对饲养。 在水面附近提供适合的小型食物，避免过量。 缸盖牢固，保留上浮通道及休息遮蔽。

en.name: Siamese Fighting Fish
en.summary: A warm-water labyrinth fish usually best planned as a single male.
en.description: Keep males separately. Use a secure lid with an air gap, gentle flow and resting places near the surface; assess tank mates individually.

zh-CN.name: 暹罗斗鱼
zh-CN.summary: 适合以单尾雄鱼规划饲养的暖水迷鳃鱼。
zh-CN.description: 雄鱼分开饲养。使用留有空气层的牢固缸盖，保持缓水流，并在近水面提供休息点；混养需逐一评估。

en.flow: Use gentle filtered circulation, especially for long fins.
en.group: Keep a single betta; do not infer pair housing from the count of one.
en.setup: Use a secure lid and surface access, with cover for resting.
en.space: Provide accessible surface and places to rest.
en.oxygen: Air breathing does not make stagnant or poor-quality water safe.
en.feeding: Offer suitable small foods near the surface without overfeeding.

zh-CN.flow: 保持缓和的过滤水流，长鳍品系尤其需要。
zh-CN.group: 单养斗鱼；数量为一不意味着可以配对饲养。
zh-CN.setup: 缸盖牢固，保留上浮通道及休息遮蔽。
zh-CN.space: 保证能到达水面，并有休息位置。
zh-CN.oxygen: 可呼吸空气也不代表停水或差水质安全。
zh-CN.feeding: 在水面附近提供适合的小型食物，避免过量。

text.en: Do not house two males together; assess any tank mates individually.
text.zh-CN: 不要同缸饲养两条雄鱼；混养对象需逐一评估。

text.en: Some tank mates may nip long fins or be attacked by the betta.
text.zh-CN: 某些混养鱼可能啄咬长鳍，或受到斗鱼攻击。

text.en: Betta can jump; keep a secure lid with access to air at the surface.
text.zh-CN: 斗鱼可能跳缸；固定缸盖，并保留水面呼吸空间。

discovery.distribution: Mainland Southeast Asia; widespread captive-bred strains

notes.en: Maintain stable filtration and gas exchange. Leave calmer water for long-finned strains. Plan for adult fish and possible offspring, not just the initial group. A small loose group can start with about 3; plan for offspring if sexes are mixed. Offer varied small foods that reach surface and midwater. Plant cover while retaining open swimming room.
notes.zh-CN: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。 为长鳍品系留有较平缓的水域。 按成鱼和可能的后代规划，而非只看初始数量。 松散小群可从约3尾起养；混养雌雄需考虑后代。 提供可到达水面和中层的多样小型食物。 有水草遮蔽，也要保留游泳空间。

en.name: Guppy
en.summary: A small livebearer with many colour strains and frequent broods.
en.description: Plan for adult females and their fry. Separating males and females helps control numbers, but previously mated females can still produce later broods; keep a rehoming plan.

zh-CN.name: 孔雀鱼
zh-CN.summary: 色彩品系丰富、繁殖速度较快的小型胎生鱼。
zh-CN.description: 按成鱼和后代的空间规划数量。公母分养有助于控制繁殖，但已交配的母鱼仍可能连续产仔，提前安排幼鱼去向。

en.flow: Leave calmer water for long-finned strains.
en.group: A small loose group can start with about 3; plan for offspring if sexes are mixed.
en.setup: Plant cover while retaining open swimming room.
en.space: Plan for adult fish and possible offspring, not just the initial group.
en.oxygen: Maintain stable filtration and gas exchange.
en.feeding: Offer varied small foods that reach surface and midwater.

zh-CN.flow: 为长鳍品系留有较平缓的水域。
zh-CN.group: 松散小群可从约3尾起养；混养雌雄需考虑后代。
zh-CN.setup: 有水草遮蔽，也要保留游泳空间。
zh-CN.space: 按成鱼和可能的后代规划，而非只看初始数量。
zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供可到达水面和中层的多样小型食物。

text.en: Mixed-sex groups may produce young quickly; plan for their care and space.
text.zh-CN: 混养雌雄可能较快繁殖；需预先考虑幼鱼照料与空间。

discovery.distribution: Northern South America; widespread captive-bred strains

notes.en: Keep the established tank filtered and oxygenated. Gentle circulation lets shrimp graze without being swept away. Usable surfaces and cover matter more than a guessed tank length. Start a colony with about 10 when space and water quality allow. Let them graze established biofilm and supplement sparingly. Provide dense cover, especially for young shrimp and molts.
notes.zh-CN: 成熟缸仍需过滤并保持充足溶氧。 缓和水流便于觅食，也避免把虾冲走。 可攀附表面与遮蔽比推测缸长更重要。 空间和水质允许时，可从约10只开始建立虾群。 以成熟生物膜为食源之一，少量补充饲料。 提供密集遮蔽，尤其保护幼虾和蜕壳个体。

en.name: Red Cherry Shrimp
en.summary: A small freshwater shrimp that grazes on surfaces and biofilm.
en.description: Provide cover, stable water and a mature grazing surface. Guard filter intakes with shrimp-safe sponge or mesh, especially for juveniles; many fish will eat shrimplets.

zh-CN.name: 樱花虾
zh-CN.summary: 会在缸体表面和生物膜上取食的小型淡水虾。
zh-CN.description: 提供躲避处、稳定水质和成熟取食表面。过滤进水口加防虾海绵或细网，尤其保护幼虾；许多鱼会捕食幼虾。

en.flow: Gentle circulation lets shrimp graze without being swept away.
en.group: Start a colony with about 10 when space and water quality allow.
en.setup: Provide dense cover, especially for young shrimp and molts.
en.space: Usable surfaces and cover matter more than a guessed tank length.
en.oxygen: Keep the established tank filtered and oxygenated.
en.feeding: Let them graze established biofilm and supplement sparingly.

zh-CN.flow: 缓和水流便于觅食，也避免把虾冲走。
zh-CN.group: 空间和水质允许时，可从约10只开始建立虾群。
zh-CN.setup: 提供密集遮蔽，尤其保护幼虾和蜕壳个体。
zh-CN.space: 可攀附表面与遮蔽比推测缸长更重要。
zh-CN.oxygen: 成熟缸仍需过滤并保持充足溶氧。
zh-CN.feeding: 以成熟生物膜为食源之一，少量补充饲料。

text.en: Many fish will eat young shrimp even when they leave adults alone.
text.zh-CN: 许多鱼即使不捕食成虾，也会捕食幼虾。

text.en: Guard the filter intake so young shrimp are not drawn in.
text.zh-CN: 给过滤进水口加防护，避免幼虾被吸入。

notes.en: Keep water well oxygenated; surface visits do not replace this. Use circulation that leaves resting spots on the bottom. Prioritize usable bottom area for the group. Keep at least 6 together; 8 or more is preferable when bottom space allows. Deliver sinking food to the bottom; do not rely on leftovers. Use smooth substrate to protect foraging barbels.
notes.zh-CN: 保持水体溶氧充足；上浮换气不能替代这一点。 让水体循环，同时在底部留有休息区。 优先保证群体可用的底面积。 至少6尾同养；底部空间允许时以8尾或更多为宜。 把沉底食物送到底层，不依赖其他鱼的剩食。 用圆润底材保护觅食时的触须。

en.name: Panda Corydoras
en.summary: A social bottom-dweller that spends much of its time sifting the substrate.
en.description: Keep a group on smooth substrate and feed a suitable sinking food. Leftover food and algae alone do not meet their needs; they are not a substitute for cleaning.

zh-CN.name: 熊猫鼠
zh-CN.summary: 喜欢群居、主要活动在底层的底栖鱼。
zh-CN.description: 使用圆润底材并保持足够群体，专门投喂合适的沉底食物。残饵和藻类不能满足它们的需要，鼠鱼也不能代替清洁。

en.flow: Use circulation that leaves resting spots on the bottom.
en.group: Keep at least 6 together; 8 or more is preferable when bottom space allows.
en.setup: Use smooth substrate to protect foraging barbels.
en.space: Prioritize usable bottom area for the group.
en.oxygen: Keep water well oxygenated; surface visits do not replace this.
en.feeding: Deliver sinking food to the bottom; do not rely on leftovers.

zh-CN.flow: 让水体循环，同时在底部留有休息区。
zh-CN.group: 至少6尾同养；底部空间允许时以8尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.setup: 用圆润底材保护觅食时的触须。
zh-CN.space: 优先保证群体可用的底面积。
zh-CN.oxygen: 保持水体溶氧充足；上浮换气不能替代这一点。
zh-CN.feeding: 把沉底食物送到底层，不依赖其他鱼的剩食。

text.en: Check that food reaches the bottom group before faster tank mates take it.
text.zh-CN: 确认食物到达底层鱼群，避免被动作较快的混养鱼先吃完。

notes.en: Maintain good water quality and gas exchange even with gentle flow. Avoid a strong current at the surface. Allow separate sheltered areas if keeping a pair. One can be kept alone; pair only with room and a backup separation plan. Offer small foods at the surface and in midwater. Provide surface cover without sealing off gas exchange.
notes.zh-CN: 即使水流缓和，也要保持良好水质与气体交换。 避免水面持续强流。 成对饲养时提供各自可躲避的区域。 可单养；成对需空间和必要时分开的预案。 提供水面和中层可摄取的小型食物。 提供水面遮蔽，但不要妨碍气体交换。

en.name: Honey Gourami
en.summary: A gentle labyrinth fish that often explores the upper half of the tank.
en.description: Keep calm tank mates and surface cover; avoid strong surface flow.

zh-CN.name: 蜜丽丽
zh-CN.summary: 性情温和、常活动于上层的迷鳃鱼。
zh-CN.description: 建议搭配安静的混养鱼，并保留水面遮蔽物，避免强水流。

en.flow: Avoid a strong current at the surface.
en.group: One can be kept alone; pair only with room and a backup separation plan.
en.setup: Provide surface cover without sealing off gas exchange.
en.space: Allow separate sheltered areas if keeping a pair.
en.oxygen: Maintain good water quality and gas exchange even with gentle flow.
en.feeding: Offer small foods at the surface and in midwater.

zh-CN.group: 可单养；成对需空间和必要时分开的预案。
zh-CN.setup: 提供水面遮蔽，但不要妨碍气体交换。
zh-CN.space: 成对饲养时提供各自可躲避的区域。
zh-CN.oxygen: 即使水流缓和，也要保持良好水质与气体交换。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供水面和中层可摄取的小型食物。

text.en: A pair may not coexist peacefully; watch for chasing and separate if needed.
text.zh-CN: 成对个体未必能和平共处；留意追逐，必要时分开。

notes.en: Keep normal filtration and gas exchange stable. Allow moderate flow with sheltered edges. Reserve a clear swimming run for the adult group. Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows. Offer appropriately sized food in midwater. Combine plant cover with open water.
notes.zh-CN: 保持稳定过滤和正常气体交换。 可有适中水流，边缘留遮蔽区。 为成鱼群体留出开阔游泳区。 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。 在中层提供合适大小的食物。 水草遮蔽与开阔水域兼顾。

en.name: Harlequin Rasbora
en.summary: A hardy mid-water schooling fish for peaceful community tanks.
en.description: Keep at least eight with cover and a clear swimming run. Size the aquarium for the adult group rather than the number of small fish sold together.

zh-CN.name: 三角灯
zh-CN.summary: 适合温和社区缸的耐养中层群游鱼。
zh-CN.description: 至少八尾群养，提供遮蔽和连续游泳空间。按成年群体规划缸体，不能以店内幼鱼装得下为标准。

en.flow: Allow moderate flow with sheltered edges.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.setup: Combine plant cover with open water.
en.space: Reserve a clear swimming run for the adult group.
en.oxygen: Keep normal filtration and gas exchange stable.
en.feeding: Offer appropriately sized food in midwater.

zh-CN.flow: 可有适中水流，边缘留遮蔽区。
zh-CN.group: 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.setup: 水草遮蔽与开阔水域兼顾。
zh-CN.space: 为成鱼群体留出开阔游泳区。
zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和正常气体交换。
zh-CN.feeding: 在中层提供合适大小的食物。

notes.en: Keep filtration and gas exchange steady. Use a gentle current with quiet planted areas. Plan space for the adult shoal, despite their small size. Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows. Use fine food that small mouths can take. Plant cover without filling the whole swim path.
notes.zh-CN: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。 采用缓和水流，并留有安静的水草区。 体型虽小，仍按成鱼群体规划空间。 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。 提供适合小口径的细小食物。 用水草遮蔽，但不要占满游泳空间。

en.name: Ember Tetra
en.summary: A tiny, warm-water schooling fish with a calm temperament.
en.description: Keep at least eight in planted cover with gentle flow. Small individual size does not remove the need for enough space for the adult group.

zh-CN.name: 火焰灯
zh-CN.summary: 体型小、性情温和的暖水群游鱼。
zh-CN.description: 至少八尾群养，提供水草遮蔽和缓水流。单尾体型小，也需要为成鱼群体保留足够空间。

en.flow: Use a gentle current with quiet planted areas.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.setup: Plant cover without filling the whole swim path.
en.space: Plan space for the adult shoal, despite their small size.
en.oxygen: Keep filtration and gas exchange steady.
en.feeding: Use fine food that small mouths can take.

zh-CN.flow: 采用缓和水流，并留有安静的水草区。
zh-CN.group: 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.setup: 用水草遮蔽，但不要占满游泳空间。
zh-CN.space: 体型虽小，仍按成鱼群体规划空间。
zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供适合小口径的细小食物。

notes.en: Keep filtered water well oxygenated. Leave a calm area beside the swimming run. Leave an uninterrupted swim path for the adult group. Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows. Offer small food that reaches midwater. Provide cover around open swimming space.
notes.zh-CN: 保持过滤水体溶氧充足。 游泳区旁留有平缓水流区域。 为成鱼群体保留连续游泳空间。 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。 提供能到达中层的小颗粒食物。 在开阔游泳区周围提供遮蔽。

en.name: Neon Tetra
en.summary: A peaceful schooling fish for mature community aquariums.
en.description: Keep at least eight and plan swimming room for the adult group, not the shop-sized juveniles. Use mature, stable water and leave an open swimming run.

zh-CN.name: 霓虹灯
zh-CN.summary: 适合成熟社区缸的温和群游鱼。
zh-CN.description: 至少八尾群养，按成鱼群体而非店内幼鱼规划空间。使用成熟稳定的水体，并保留连续游泳空间。

en.flow: Leave a calm area beside the swimming run.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.setup: Provide cover around open swimming space.
en.space: Leave an uninterrupted swim path for the adult group.
en.feeding: Offer small food that reaches midwater.

zh-CN.feeding: 提供能到达中层的小颗粒食物。
